You're out!No respawns in Survival. Watch the rest of this round, or skip it:
Touch: left thumb anywhere on the lower left moves · drag anywhere else to look, pinch to zoom · tap to shoot there, hold a finger still to keep firing · while reloading, tap as the marker crosses the gold · melee is automatic · the gun button cycles guns · the Roll button dodges · the gear menu has the modes
WASD move · Space jump · Shift dodge roll · Q / E turn the camera
Click shoot (hold for full auto) · Melee is automatic: you bash (and fling) anything that gets close · Active reload: while reloading, press R (or click) as the marker crosses the bar: gold = instant + hot mag, white = instant · R reload · 1 / 2 your two guns · V bash · T switch special rounds · Tab every team's players
Right-drag or middle-drag turn the camera · Mouse wheel zoom · M or the gear: menu (mouse lock, modes)
Teams: White, Orange, Black and Blue, one on each side of the map. Your team is outlined in blue, everyone else in red. Your own team's bullets pass through you
Zone 1 is the middle of the map: the supply is there, and most of the zombies. Zombies can't get into a base (yours heals you and loads your guns)
Supply Run: grab red crates in Zone 1 (walk near to pull them in, up to 10) and bring them into your base: each one stored is a point. Go down and you drop what you carry
Capture the Flag: grab an enemy flag from the stand at the back of their base, bring it to yours. Your own flag has to be home to score. Touch your dropped flag to send it home
Deathmatch: takedowns score for your team. Survival: the same with no respawns, last team standing wins. Out early? Join a round that's already going
Loot: a few guns wait in Zone 1's houses under beams of light. You carry two: walking into one swaps it for the one in your hands. Ammo is endless; ammo boxes hold Fire, Ice and Shock rounds (for zombies)
